baseline.configuration: G1 (16-wide tile, banked2) + G2 (Mode B) + G3 (3 cores)

LOO_G1_fragment_layout_32col.description: Force 32-wide columns instead of conservative 16-wide tile
LOO_G1_fragment_layout_32col.verdict: 32-column is 2.50x slower on unaligned/small shapes; conservative 16-column default justified

LOO_G2_pipeline_singlerole.description: Use single-role execution instead of Mode B
LOO_G2_pipeline_singlerole.verdict: Mode B provides overlap without double-buffering overhead

LOO_G3_active_cores.description: Run on 1 core instead of 3 cores
LOO_G3_active_cores.verdict: Multicore scaling provides ~2.9x throughput on independent tile grids

G1_layout_x_G2_pipeline.verdict: Slight negative synergy due to increased register pressure in wide tiles under single role
